question: history of panama city beach, fl
answer: Panama City Beach, located in Florida, has a rich history dating back to around 13,000 years ago during the last ice age. The ancient shell midden at Oaks By The Bay Park is one of the few surviving landmarks from this time period. Over time, Panama City Beach developed into a popular tourist destination due to its beautiful white sand and warm Gulf waters. In the 1920s, J.E. Churchwell moved to the area and purchased land that was previously known as Long Beach Resort. This land was later renamed Long Beach Island, and in the 1940s, his nephew, Guy Churchwell, moved there as well. In the 1970s, the City of Panama City Beach was incorporated, and Guy Churchwell became the Mayor of the new city.
